Technology amplifies our work. We have connected 154 million people to broadband internet and 86 million people to digitally enabled services so they can access markets, improve their skills, use better public services, and participate more fully in the modern economy.
We have fully embraced AI tools at the World Bank Group, and we support clients to adopt, adapt, and then advance them for their own needs. Our client engagements focus on Small AI — affordable, fit-for-purpose solutions designed for local conditions, including places with limited power, connectivity, and computing capacity. Our three-pillar strategy leverages the World Bank Group’s unique capabilities. First, the World Bank and IFC strengthen the foundations of family farms by investing in physical and human capital, such as rural roads and research. Then, they align regulations, streamline standards, repurpose subsidies, and remove barriers to doing business. Finally, the World Bank Group expands access to finance through MIGA’s guarantees and insurance, as well as partnerships created by the World Bank and IFC. The private sector is a critical partner across all three pillars.
